title: Exploring Lower MutantMania
description: Exploring Lower MutantMania — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many branches connected to Lower MutantMania. Afterward, return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many branches connected to Lower MutantMania. Afterward, return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Upper MutantMania is a rough and chaotic place, of that there can be no doubt. But, as you progress to Lower MutantMania, note how chaos becomes order, how amateurs become professionals.

Gather your courage, Dungeon Runner. Venture into the branches of Lower MutantMania. After you have done so, return to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You're back? Please...pardon me. I did not mean to imply that I didn't expect that you would ever return, but, well, I didn't expect that you would ever return. Well done, Dungeon Runner!

Objectives:

  • Explore the Limitless Lower Locationals
  • Explore the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle
  • Explore Purpose-Pondering Peak

Client level range: 80–100
